# Rent Resilience

> Agentic infrastructure that resolves housing obligations and turns verified rent
> history into portable, privacy-preserving financial resilience, on Base with
> x402-paid proof and payment APIs.

Rent Resilience represents rent as verifiable obligations in an append-only,
event-sourced ledger. Private facts (PII, leases, amounts detail) never touch the
chain; periodic Merkle commitments anchor event history to Base. Agents resolve
shortfalls by composing landlord flexibility, assistance, and financing in that order —
borrowing last. External agents pay in USDC over x402 for proofs, verification,
provider discovery, and resolution quotes.

This is Kyle Brodeur's project; built in public. MIT licensed.

## Paid endpoints (x402)

- POST https://rentresilience.org/api/optin — 0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia → early-access receipt. Live spike.
- GET  https://rentresilience.org/api/optin — returns the 402 price sheet without payment.
- POST https://rentresilience.org/api/confirm — verify a plain 0.01 USDC transfer by tx hash (wallet-app flow, Base mainnet).

Two lanes: agents use the strict 402 handshake on Base Sepolia (free, x402 facilitator). Humans with a wallet app use the EIP-681 QR, send 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet, and confirm by tx hash.

x402 price sheet fields: scheme exact, asset USDC 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e, network base-sepolia, maxAmountRequired 10000 atomic units (0.01 USDC), payTo 0x79588BB628c741d073FD3bC47685328Cf8aD6802.

Verification endpoints (/v1/proofs/*, /v1/verify/*, /v1/resolution/*) ship with the
sandbox in four weeks; see the roadmap.
